nar.text: Varzi felt motivated because the 2500 Maserati was a faster car than the old Alfa P2.

After the spectators had been warmed up, the starting area was cleared for the main event where 20 cars took their positions on the grid in numerical order.
Maggi's Bugatti led the 20-car field from the front row as the loud thundering cars shot away.
However, Arcangeli, Nuvolari and Fagioli passed Maggi after Capelle on the fast section to Montesilvano.
At the end of the first lap Arcangeli in the 16-cylinder Maserati was in front at an average speed of 123.287 km/h, leading Nuvolari, Fagioli, Maserati and Varzi.
Renzi retires his Bugatti; Ferrari and Spinozzi trail a long way behind.

At the end of the second lap Arcangeli was even further ahead of Nuvolari and had increased the gap to more than half a minute.
Fagioli set a new fastest lap time of 12m20s equal to 124 km/h average speed and was now only four seconds behind Nuvolari.
Varzi overhauled Maserati, leading him by three seconds.
Maggi, Renzi, del Drago, Ferrari and Spinozzi are out; 15 cars remain.

After the third lap Arcangeli's lead had now been cut to eight seconds by Nuvolari.
Fagioli in third place established a new fastest lap at 12m11s, which was a new record.

The fourth lap produced an exciting scene at the finish-line. Nuvolari was now first with Arcangeli barely one second behind.
About 300 meters beyond the finish line Arcangeli had a tire burst at top speed on the straight.
Arcangeli's Maserati hits the gate of a country house; he is out, without serious injury.

On lap six Nuvolari lost the lead. His pace had slowed and he was falling back.
Fagioli was the first to pass the slowing Alfa at Capelle. Next Varzi went by and then Ernesto Maserati passed the stricken Alfa Romeo.
Fagioli leads Varzi and Maserati; Nuvolari, fourth, pits for new plugs.

Brivio passes Nuvolari.

But then came a dramatic turn of events at the last turn at the center of Montesilvano, just a few kilometers from the finish. The pinion of the differential broke and Fagioli's Maserati rolled to a stop.
Varzi passes his stranded teammate and wins; Maserati second, Borzacchini third, then Brivio, Nuvolari and Caflisch.
Finally Fagioli appeared with his stricken car, 17m5s after the victor and pushed by a group of enthusiastic spectators.
